title: 生成式 AI 生产率实证研究
title_en: Empirical studies of generative AI and productivity
notes: 效应为各研究报告的百分比，须线表示 95% 置信区间。客服研究的区间由本站依据论文系数与标准误推算。客服与写作研究的区间单位分别为“每小时解决问题数”和“标准差”，与百分比轴不同，只在详情中以文字给出、不画须线。各研究的任务、样本与指标不同，不可直接横向比较。
notes_en: Effects are the percentages reported by each study; whiskers show 95% confidence intervals. The customer-support interval is derived by this site from the paper's coefficient and standard error. The intervals for the customer-support and writing studies are in resolutions per hour and standard deviations rather than percentages, so they appear as text in the details only, without whiskers. Tasks, samples and metrics differ across studies, so they cannot be compared directly.

records.design: 在一家企业分阶段引入生成式 AI 助手，比较引入前后与未引入者的工作效率。
records.design_en: A generative AI assistant was rolled out in stages at one company; productivity was compared before and after rollout and against agents without access.
records.ci_note: 本站由 QJE 论文主规格系数 0.301、标准误 0.0329 按 ±1.96 倍标准误计算，论文未直接列出区间；单位为每小时解决问题数（绝对值），不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Computed by this site from the QJE paper's main-specification coefficient (0.301) and standard error (0.0329) as ±1.96 standard errors; the paper does not list the interval itself. Units are resolutions per hour (absolute), not percentages

records.short: 客服 · 新手与低技能
records.design: 同一客服研究中新手和低技能员工的结果；每小时解决问题数提升约 30%。
records.design_en: Results for less experienced and lower-skilled workers in the same customer-support study; issues resolved per hour increased by about 30%.

records.metric: 完成 HTTP 服务器任务的速度
records.metric_en: Speed of completing an HTTP server task
records.design: 随机对照实验：实验组可用 GitHub Copilot，用 JavaScript 实现 HTTP 服务器。
records.design_en: Randomised controlled experiment: the treatment group could use GitHub Copilot to implement an HTTP server in JavaScript.

records.short: 写作 · 完成时间缩短
records.design: 预注册在线实验：中级专业写作任务，随机分配 ChatGPT 使用权。
records.design_en: Pre-registered online experiment: mid-level professional writing tasks, with access to ChatGPT randomly assigned.
records.ci_note: Science 正式版图中的标准化效应及 95% 置信区间；单位为标准差，不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Standardised effect and 95% confidence interval shown in a figure of the published Science version; units are standard deviations, not percentages

records.design_en: Quality ratings from the same experiment.
records.ci_note: Science 正式版图中的标准化效应及 95% 置信区间；单位为标准差，不是百分比
records.ci_note_en: Standardised effect and 95% confidence interval shown in a figure of the published Science version; units are standard deviations, not percentages

records.sample_unit: 名资深开发者（246 个真实任务）
records.design: 随机对照试验：主要使用 Cursor Pro + Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet，在自己熟悉的大型开源仓库中完成真实任务。
records.design_en: Randomised controlled trial: developers mainly used Cursor Pro + Claude 3.5/3.7 Sonnet to complete real tasks in large open-source repositories they knew well.
records.version_note: 反例：使用 AI 工具后耗时反而增加。
records.version_note_en: Counter-example: using AI tools actually increased completion time.
